$description: Timeline (platform/components/Timeline, library wave 8, lane C): its component tokens. The markers and the line are neutral roles: they show order, not state.

timeline-item-gap.$description: Timeline: the space between one event and the next (vertical).

timeline-column-gap.$description: Timeline: the space between the marker and the content (and between events, horizontal).

timeline-marker-size.$description: Timeline: the marker's box, and the height of the content's first line, so the two share a middle.

timeline-dot-size.$description: Timeline: the small circle of an event without an icon.

timeline-icon-marker-background.$description: Timeline: the circle behind an event's icon (with icons).

timeline-icon-marker-border-width.$description: Timeline: the icon circle's border width.

timeline-icon-size.$description: Timeline: an event's icon size (16px in the 24px circle).

timeline-line-color.$description: Timeline: the line between the markers.

timeline-content-row-gap.$description: Timeline: the space between the time, the title, the description and the content.

timeline-heading-gap.$description: Timeline: the space between the title and its badge.

timeline-time-font-family.$description: Timeline: the date or time is a technical value (Reddit Mono).

timeline-time-font-size.$description: Timeline: the date or time's size.

timeline-description-text.$description: Timeline: the line or two about the event.

timeline-horizontal-item-width.$description: Timeline: an event's width in a horizontal timeline.

timeline-focus-outline-color.$description: Timeline: the focus ring of a horizontal timeline (a scrolling region, one Tab stop).
